row.title: YEAR-SIM-1 and SAY-DO-1: a year unattended is simulated against the real recovery code; words are probed against code
row.body: Measured 2026-11-21: horizon p10 730 days (99.5% of 200 simulated years pass 365) after MODEL-HEAL-1 and DEP-LOOP-1; strict p10 50 days, killers token-revoked and domain-renewal (identity gates). Self rate 0.214 substantive server-originated changes a day against 1, the largest remaining gap. Say-do match 0.993. Fix items close themselves when their probe passes.
